title: See the sessions another session started
done: That is it: a session started by another is always listed beneath it.

steps.caption: A session can start other sessions to work beside it. The Sessions panel lists each one beneath the session that started it.
Here, Demo: tidy the docs was started by the session above it: it is indented, and its second line says so.
The arrow beside a session folds away the sessions it started. Its title then counts them.
Click it again, and they are listed once more.
Your turn: fold the sessions the demo session started.
